decisions.why: Examples are EcoSharps Flat Pack Sharps Bin, a sharps container and a recycled sharps container, direct sharps-container products.
The one example is a Cytotoxic Waste Bag, a clinical waste container, matching the sharps/clinical-waste category.
Examples are Corning culture dishes and Appleton/Sterilin petri dishes, standard laboratory consumables.
Examples are Corning and Pyrex 5ml centrifuge/conical prep tubes, generic laboratory consumables.
Examples are appCELL and Falcon cell strainers, laboratory consumables used for sample/tissue processing.
The one example is a haematological sample vial, matching the blood collection tubes and systems category.
Examples are Swann Morton scalpel blades and disposable sterile scalpels, general theatre/procedure consumables.
The one example is a powder-free blue nitrile examination glove.
The one example, ecoSHIELD Eco Nitrile PF 250 Gloves, is a nitrile examination glove line.
The one example is a chemical-resistant Shield Scientific nitrile glove for protective (not examination) use, matching general PPE.
